# Lab 22.5: JDBC/ODBC & Third-Party BI

## What We Are Going to Do
Connect a third-party BI tool to BigQuery using the Simba JDBC/ODBC drivers or the tool's native connector. This is a demo on your own computer.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create a service account for the BI tool.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam service-accounts create bi-tool --display-name="BI tool"
BI_SA=bi-tool@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID --member=serviceAccount:$BI_SA --role=roles/bigquery.jobUser --quiet
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false "GRANT \`roles/bigquery.dataViewer\` ON SCHEMA lab22 TO 'serviceAccount:$BI_SA'"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Use a dedicated service account with read-only data access. Prefer workload identity or OAuth over downloaded keys where the tool supports it.

2. **[Console] Download the drivers.** From the BigQuery docs page **ODBC and JDBC drivers**, download the latest Simba driver for your OS.

3. **Configure the connection.** For ODBC/JDBC set:
   - **Project ID**: `bq-course-lab`
   - **Auth**: OAuth (user) or service account
   - **Use Storage Read API for large results**: on

4. **Connect a tool.** In Power BI use **Get Data → Google BigQuery**; in Tableau use **Connect → Google BigQuery**. Pick `lab22.sales` and build one chart.

5. **[SQL] Find the tool's queries.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT user_email, creation_time, LEFT(query, 80) AS q
FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_BY_PROJECT
WHERE user_email LIKE 'bi-tool@%'
ORDER BY creation_time DESC LIMIT 10;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Drivers | Simba JDBC/ODBC |
| Native connectors | Power BI, Tableau and others |
| Identity | Read-only service account |
| Large results | Storage Read API |
